text:
tori_csm: Need a super-compact Go-live Light Card for customers — one-column checklist + tiny ops snippets. AMs should be able to paste it into an email.
pat_eng: I'll draft. Important to call out network preflight (NAT/proxy/TLS) — lots of customer trouble there.
jamie_sre: Add streaming concurrency caveat and a circuit-breaker suggestion. Also note memory pressure on hosts with many streams.
ali_cs: Customers want a single approval line and a 3-question post-priming check. Keep wording copyable.
pat_eng: Draft checklist (copy/paste for customers):
1) Preflight: confirm API key, model pin (exact), and outbound network egress (no blocking proxies).
2) Approve a 30-min priming window.
3) Run priming: sample ~15 representative flows (include long prefixes).
4) Keep warm_instances >= 2 for 2h after launch.
5) Run 5 golden checks and report latency + any odd outputs.
6) If thresholds hit, follow escalation (below).
jamie_sre: Tiny infra snippet to hand to platform team (YAML):
```yaml
go_live:
  preflight: [api_key, model_pin, network_egress]
  priming:
    enabled: true
    sample: 15
    warm_instances: 2
serving:
  batch:
    max_requests: 4
    window_ms: 40
  streaming: preferred
  cache:
    prefix_ttl_s: 300
```
pat_eng: Console queries AMs can paste to monitor in real time:
```query
rate(inference_errors_total{tenant="${tenant}"}[5m])
avg_over_time(latency_ms{model="${model}"}[5m])
success_rate(prompt_set="golden", window=1h)
sum(rate(support_tickets_total{product="chat"}[1h]))
```
ali_cs: Customer approval one-liner (paste into calendar invite):
"Please approve 30 minutes for a short traffic sample to warm model instances and cache common prefixes so end-users see fast responses."
pat_eng: Post-priming micro-survey (pasteable):
Subject: "Priming finished  quick check"
Body bullets: "1) Outputs matched expectations? (Yes/No) 2) Avg latency observed (ms) 3) Any errors/timeouts or odd completions?"
jamie_sre: Escalation triggers (recommend):
- errors > 3x baseline for 10m -> page #eng-oncall and create ticket tagged onboarding:high-risk.
- golden prompt success rate drop >= 25% vs baseline over 1h -> notify AM + open triage ticket.
- avg latency >= 2x baseline for 20m -> run fallback (route 10% to smaller model) + page oncall.
jamie_sre: Automation suggestion: alert -> create ticket + attach golden prompt diffs and a 1h latency trend.
pat_eng: Troubleshooting order (copyable to runbook):
1) verify exact model pin and quantization profile; revert if quality regressed.
2) check network egress / proxy logs (common root cause).
3) confirm warm_instances and that prefill job completed.
4) if tail latency high -> lower batch.max_requests or increase window_ms.
5) if streaming errors -> reduce concurrent streams or set streaming=false temporarily.
6) if quality or errors persist -> route 10% traffic to a smaller, known-good model and collect traces.
opsbot: Internal: created template -> /ops/templates/go-live-light-job.yaml :white_check_mark:
tori_csm: Nice. I'll format into a one-pager and add an AM-ready email with the approval line + survey. Please review wording by EOD.
pat_eng: Reviewed, tiny wording tweak, lgtm.
jamie_sre: I'll add alert rules to the runbook repo after you publish.
ali_cs: I'll prep AM snippets and put them in the playbook under "one-liners".
tori_csm: Thanks team — this should be short enough for customers to read and act on.
